web.instruction: Check user-visible behavior, responsive states, accessibility, and relevant web tests.

strategy.instruction: Compare status quo and credible options with explicit criteria and uncertainty.

data-analytics.instruction: Apply validated data and metric methods without replacing the owning primary pipeline.

content-analysis.instruction: Apply a traceable coding and interpretation method without replacing the owning primary pipeline.

research-synthesis.instruction: Select the narrow research mode and evidence standard needed by the owning pipeline.

reviewer-response.instruction: Map concern to actual problem, change, location, and evidence.

thesis-review.instruction: Gate intake and section maturity first, then review problem, literature, objectives, method, evidence, and references before language.

external-feedback.instruction: Define hypothesis, source, method, and decision rule for real feedback.

publication-production.instruction: Build and verify the project-approved written or reflowable artifact.
publication-production.cadence: per publication build, conversion, export, or final QA

presentation-production.instruction: Build, render, inspect, and behavior-test the real deck outputs.
presentation-production.cadence: per deck build, render, export, or final QA

markdown-cleanup.instruction: Inventory and migrate Markdown without deleting recoverable source material.
markdown-cleanup.cadence: on explicit cleanup or recovery request

package-release.instruction: Run version, integrity, privacy-boundary, test, tag, publication, and public-manifest gates.

prose-style.instruction: Check reader-facing prose after content is stable; never alter facts or claim strength merely to satisfy style counts.

release-boundary.instruction: Verify that tracked and packaged files contain no blocked private paths, credentials, keys, or unapproved product intelligence.
release-boundary.cadence: before commit, tag, package, or public release

resume.instruction: Use current state first and read history only if insufficient.

existing-project-onboarding.instruction: Profile an existing project whose state is missing or placeholder.

machine-discovery.instruction: Revalidate only missing, stale, changed, or task-required machine facts.

document-style-bootstrap.instruction: Establish a document style and production contract only when missing.
